name: Saunatonttu
body:
SAUNATONTTU
CR 5

This thin, spindly man has enormous bushy whiskers that cover nearly as much of his body as his tunic and trousers. His feet are bare and his head is topped with a pointed blue cap. Faint wisps of steam surround him.

XP 1,600
NG Tiny fey
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +15
Aura steam shroud (5 feet, 1d6 fire damage, DC 16)

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 15, flat-footed 14 (+2 armor, +3 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)
hp 51 (8d6+16)
Fort +5, Ref +9, Will +8
Defensive Abilities domain warden; DR 5/cold iron; Resist fire 20

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee sauna whisk +8 (1d4-1 nonlethal plus 1d6 fire)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks steaming breath (15-foot cone, 2d6 fire damage, Fortitude DC 15 for half, usable every 1d4 rounds)
Spell-like Abilities (CL 5th; concentration +8)

At will—create water, gaseous form (self only), obscuring mist, purify food and drink, rite of bodily purity, rite of centered mind, touch of fatigue (DC 13)
3/day—heat metal (DC 15), ray of exhaustion (DC 16)
1/day—geyser (DC 18), tiny hut

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 15, Cha 16
Base Atk +4; CMB +4; CMD 14
Feats Dodge, Skill Focus (Perception, Stealth), Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +14, Bluff +14, Diplomacy +14, Disguise +14, Escape Artist +14, Perception +13, Sleight of Hand +14, Stealth +18
Languages Common, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Mistsight (Ex)

A saunatonttu can see through steam, fog, mist, and precipitation like rain or snow as if they were perfectly clear, negating miss chance for such conditions.

Relaxing Rite (Su)

When a saunatonttu casts rite of bodily purity or rite of centered mind in a sauna, it can share the results of the rite with up to 6 other creatures sharing the sauna. A creature can’t benefit from the saunatonttu’s rite more than once per day.

Sauna Whisk (Su)

A saunatonttu wields a bundle of evergreen branches infused with scalding hot water. If it hits the target’s touch AC, the whisk deals 1d6 fire damage even if the attack misses the target’s normal AC. A saunatonttu can instead use the hot water and herbal infusion of its whisk to heal hurts. If not in a sauna, it requires three consecutive rounds of gently striking the target as a full-round action (which does not harm them), 63 after which the target regains 1d8 hit points and is affected as lesser restoration. If the saunatonttu and their ally are in a sauna, this treatment can be done with a single full-round action and heals 2d8 hit points while removing one of the following conditions: dazed, fatigued, shaken, sickened, or stunned. A creature can benefit from the treatment of a saunatonttu’s whisk only once per day.

Steaming Breath (Su)

Creatures failing their save against a saunatonttu’s steaming breath become fatigued, in addition to damage dealt.

Steam Shroud (Su)

A saunatonttu is surrounded by wisps of steam, which deal 1d6 fire damage (DC 16 Fortitude negates) to creatures entering or beginning their turn within this area. The steam grants it a 20% miss chance against attacks from more than 5 feet away and allow it to make Stealth checks even when observed. It can choose to dismiss or resume its aura as a free action. If the saunatonttu is inside a sauna, as a full-round it can expand its aura to affect all creatures within the sauna. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

Saunatonttu are kindly fey related to haltija who watch over the steaming saunas that are an essential part of life in some subarctic cultures. They usually appear as elderly humanoids of the same type as the builder of their sauna domain, though rarely they appear as beardless youths.

Saunatonttu’s welcome those who respect the sanctity of the sauna and often share stories of long ago with those who remain for a sweat. Those who do not respect the quiet and contemplation or who try to rush the saunatonttu into conversation will quickly earn its ire.
